STEP 0 — DEEP RESEARCH FIRST (DO THIS BEFORE ANYTHING ELSE — MANDATORY)
Before writing a single word of narration or any image prompt, thoroughly RESEARCH the given Topic and Source Material. Do not skip this. A shallow script produces a failed video.

Research silently and establish:

Verified core facts — what actually happened, who was involved, where and when. Separate confirmed fact from legend, regional retelling, and popular myth.

The single strongest HOOK ANGLE — the most surprising, emotional, or high-stakes entry point a cold viewer would stop scrolling for.

The core EMOTION of this episode (one word) and the single PAYOFF the viewer gets at the end.

Visual opportunities — which 3–5 moments are inherently cinematic and what each looks like (era, location, costume, light, scale).

Uncertainties — anything sources disagree on or you cannot verify. NEVER invent quotations, Sanskrit verses, dates, statistics, dialogue from scripture, or miracles presented as scientific proof. Omit unsupported specifics or qualify them briefly.

Only after this research is solid, proceed to the workflow below. Source fidelity over invention — but emotion and clarity over dry recitation.

🕉️ RAMAYANA — ADI KAVYA
MASTER PROMPT FILE (Merged) — Version 7.3 IMAGE-ONLY
Bible + Script Prompt + Image-Only Production Prompt + Workflow Guide, in one document — Static Visual Edition
This single file merges the four original documents into one IMAGE-ONLY visual production system. It enforces a strict TWO-TAG SYSTEM:

Audio Narration Tag: Exactly one <script>...</script> block housing the clean TTS-ready narration.

Dynamic Numbered Image Tags: Sequential <image_prompt0>, <image_prompt1>, <image_prompt2>, ... <image_prompt[N]> tags enclosing each self-contained still generation prompt.

All AI video, motion prompts, and animation directions are completely removed. Every visual asset is a detailed, static prompt.

📑 TABLE OF CONTENTS
WORKFLOW GUIDE — how to use this file

THE BIBLE — static reference (Character Bible, Location Bible, Visual Style, Religious Accuracy Law, Negative Prompt, Style Tags)

SCRIPT PROMPT — creative pass (run first)

PRODUCTION PROMPT — asset pass (run second)

How to Use the Split System
THE THREE DOCUMENTS (Parts of this one file)
THE BIBLE — Static reference. Contains: Character Bible, Location Bible, Visual Style, Religious Accuracy Law, Universal Negative Prompt, Universal Style Tags.

THE SCRIPT PROMPT — Creative pass. Run FIRST. Output: locked Hindi script (Sections 1, 2, 2B) with Section 2B wrapped in <script>...</script>.

THE PRODUCTION PROMPT — IMAGE-ONLY asset pass. Run SECOND. Takes locked script + Bible → outputs static prompts in <image_prompt[n]> tags plus overlays and reflection prompts (Sections 3, 4, 5). Never modifies script, never writes video prompts.

👥 CHARACTER BIBLE — NEVER CHANGE THESE DESCRIPTIONS
Copy relevant character details into EVERY image prompt.

🔵 RAMA
Age: 25–30 years old

Skin: Deep blue-dark complexion ("shyama varna") — non-negotiable, never fair

Face: Strong jaw, high forehead, calm and powerful eyes, slightly arched eyebrows

Body: Tall, broad shoulders, long arms reaching knees ("ajanubahu")

Hair: Long black hair tied in an ascetic knot (jata) or warrior bun

Palace attire: Yellow/gold silk dhoti, ornate crown (mukut), gold jewelry, bow Sharanga

Forest/Exile attire: Ochre/saffron bark-cloth dhoti, matted hair, no crown, bow and quiver

Expression: Dignified, compassionate, serene, divine majesty — never angry or anxious

🌟 SITA
Age: 20–25 years old

Skin: Golden-fair radiant complexion ("suvarna varna")

Face: Large expressive eyes, gentle grace, oval face, long black hair

Palace attire: Rich red and gold silk saree, elaborate traditional jewelry

Forest attire: Simple ochre or cream cotton saree, minimal wooden/seed jewelry, braided hair

Lanka captivity attire: Worn pale saree, unadorned, solemn dignity, sorrowful yet resilient eyes

Expression: Graceful, resolute, devoted — never weak or helpless

🏹 LAKSHMANA
Age: 22–27 years old

Skin: Fair wheatish complexion

Face: Sharp warrior features, intense alert eyes, strong jaw

Body: Highly athletic, muscular build

Attire: Similar to Rama's palette in green/ochre, carrying formidable longbow and quiver

Expression: Fiercely vigilant, protective, intense loyalty

🐒 HANUMAN
Form: Powerful Vanara warrior, golden-orange fur, upright muscular physique, tail arched gracefully

Attire: Simple sacred loincloth (kaupin), sacred thread (janeu), mace (gada)

Expression: Deep devotional surrender, awe-inspiring strength, humble eyes

Scale: Explicitly specify normal human scale OR mountain-sized colossal form (vishwaroopa)

👑 RAVANA
Age: 40–50 years old appearance — imposing sovereign

Skin: Dark bronze with fiery crimson undertone

Face: Ten heads (in wide establishing shots) OR dominant majestic central head (in close-ups)

Attire: Black and blood-red royal silk, heavy gold armor, jeweled crowns, multiple armed weapons

Expression: Regal arrogance, unyielding pride, formidable authority — never cartoonish

🗺️ LOCATION BIBLE
Ayodhya Palace: Treta Yuga Vedic stone architecture, colossal carved pillars, oil lamps, marigold drapes, sacred havan smoke, warm amber-gold light.

Dandaka / Panchavati Forest: Dense primordial Indian jungle, towering sal/banyan trees, hanging roots, morning mist, sacred thatched ashram hut with a quiet dhuni fire.

Chitrakuta: Peaceful sacred hills, clear streams, gentle deer, untouched natural serenity.

Lanka: Imposing black stone and gold architecture atop jagged sea-cliffs, towering spires, dramatic stormy or twilight skies.

Ashoka Vatika: Melancholic royal garden, weeping ashoka trees with scarlet blooms, oppressive luxury framing captivity.

Kishkindha: Massive granite caves, carved mountain redoubts, waterfalls, primitive grandeur.

Ram Setu / Ocean Shore: Craggy shoreline, endless churning ocean, massive floating sandstone boulders inscribed with holy names, vast Vanara host.

⚠️ RELIGIOUS ACCURACY LAW
Rama must always have blue-dark skin.

Treta Yuga setting only: absolute zero modern elements, modern clothing, or foreign architecture.

Sacred Vedic attributes (tilak, janeu, agni, mudras) must be visually accurate.

Plaintext

Take raw content and output a locked Hindi script. Never generate images or visual prompts in this pass.

Content Setup & Rules
Hook Rule: First 3–6 words spoken must combine Emotion + One Withheld Fact. No channel greetings or series titles.

Midpoint Re-Hook: At 50–60% mark, introduce a 5–8 word revelation or sudden reversal.

Language: Simple, poignant, spoken Devanagari Hindi with temple-katha resonance.

Ending: Story reaches completion first; followed by ONE single 3-second closing blessing line.

Your ONLY job is to take the LOCKED script and generate all STATIC visual assets and engagement text.
